meta.name: search-console
meta.description: Query and operate connected Google Search Console properties through NotFair MCP. Use for live GSC query or page performance, clicks, impressions, CTR, position, traffic changes, indexing status, URL inspection, sitemap reads or approved sitemap submission/removal, and Search Console MCP setup. Route full-site SEO audits to seo-analysis.
